description: Price, shipping cost, lead time and allergen information for an edible photo macaron set. Call this before ordering so you can tell the person what it costs and what is in it. Pass the delivery ZIP to get a firm shipping cost and total: it is the same live carrier rate place_order will book for that ZIP. Without a ZIP the reply is "$67 plus shipping".

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. "CA" or "NY". Optional; wording only.

zip.description: Five-digit US delivery ZIP, e.g. "90028". Optional; gives a firm shipping quote.

name: get_pricing
title: Get pricing, delivery and allergens
